Markets.title: Yes Bank moves SC seeking review of order on writing off of Rs 8,415 cr AT-1 bonds
Markets.summary: Yes Bank has asked the Supreme Court to review an October 15 order that upheld a Bombay High Court ruling quashing the write-off of Rs 8,415 crore in AT-1 bonds. The High Court had previously determined that the bank's administrator lacked the authority to write off these bonds during the financial crisis.

Markets.title: RHI Magnesita Q2 net profit jumps 62 pc to over Rs 62 cr
Markets.summary: RHI Magnesita reported a 62 percent jump in net profit to Rs 62.09 crore for the September quarter. The company's consolidated revenue rose to Rs 1,038.26 crore while overall expenses decreased compared to the previous year.

Markets.title: Mahanadi Coalfields files RHP for proposed IPO worth nearly Rs 9,500 crore
Markets.summary: Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields has filed a Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering to sell a 10 percent stake. The proposed IPO involves an offer for sale of roughly 66.18 crore equity shares to raise nearly Rs 9,500 crore.

Markets.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Can Nifty bulls overcome key resistance levels?
Markets.summary: The Nifty index has a positive technical outlook and recently rebounded from its 200-week moving average. However, it is currently approaching a key overhead resistance level.

Markets.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks gain for 5 days in a row
Markets.summary: Eight selected stocks recorded continuous gains for five consecutive days. These equities generated cumulative returns between 7% and 11% over the period.

Markets.title: Binance targets full reopening of withdrawals by next week
Markets.summary: Binance plans to fully reopen withdrawals for all networks and assets by the end of next week. The exchange is restoring operations after recovering 95% of the $6.3 billion lost in an October hack and has pledged to fully reimburse affected clients.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urged the United States and Elon Musk to lift restrictions on Starlink satellite services in Ukraine. He stated that these current limitations are hindering Ukraine's ability to defend itself against Russian attacks.

Geo-Political.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
Geo-Political.summary: Iran launched a drone attack on a US military base in Bahrain. This marks the second strike in three days amid ongoing tensions between the US and Iran over the Strait of Hormuz.

Geo-Political.title: Three men sentenced to death in Jordan over fatal church mass shooting
Geo-Political.summary: A Jordanian court has sentenced three men to death for a fatal mass shooting at a Greek Orthodox church funeral last month. The attack resulted in the deaths of nine people and injured 34 others.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
Geo-Political.summary: Han Won-seok, the top scorer on South Korea's tax accountancy exam, confessed to cheating. He admitted to using a hidden camera and artificial intelligence to achieve his near-perfect score.

Geo-Political.title: Pope Leo rides in helicopter cockpit during Peru trip
Geo-Political.summary: During his Latin America tour, the Pope rode in the cockpit of a helicopter. This flight took place shortly before his arrival in Cusco on the penultimate day of his trip.

Geo-Political.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
Geo-Political.summary: Megaspeed stated that a suspected Chinese spy linked to Nvidia's former CEO departed the company in 2025. This scandal has raised concerns about whether advanced artificial intelligence chips reached China in violation of United States export restrictions.

Data & Insights.title: Oil, El Niño and capital flight: Can India retain its fast-growth tag?
Data & Insights.summary: Although India is currently the world's fastest-growing major economy, rising crude oil prices, dry weather, and market outflows threaten its growth. These unexpected external pressures will soon test the country's economic resilience.

Data & Insights.title: Why your monthly grocery bill is rising: Onion prices jump 116%, garlic 61% as South India feels inflation heat
Data & Insights.summary: In October, retail inflation for onions surged by 116% and garlic by 61%, significantly increasing household grocery costs. All five South Indian states experienced retail inflation rates above the national average of 6.09%.

Data & Insights.title: Indian solar manufacturers look to Germany as China proposes curbs on technology exports
Data & Insights.summary: China is proposing curbs on solar technology exports that could negatively impact India's goal of building a domestic solar manufacturing ecosystem. Specifically, these restrictions threaten India's projection to reach 100 gigawatts of capacity for polysilicon, ingots, and wafers by the end of the decade.

Data & Insights.title: Trade deficit widens to 1-year high of $39.88 billion in October on record imports
Data & Insights.summary: India's trade deficit widened to a one-year high of $39.88 billion in October due to a record surge in imports. Although both exports and imports experienced strong growth, the absolute increase in imports outpaced exports.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation hits 6.09% in October, crosses RBI's upper tolerance limit
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding economists' expectations of 6%. This rate surpasses the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit of 6% for the first time in two years.

Data & Insights.title: 'New state law to shield investors in Andhra Pradesh'
Data & Insights.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning a new Investment Protection Act and escrow accounts to reassure investors about policy continuity. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu is also introducing reforms to accelerate business and economic growth.

India.title: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta Celebrates Chhath Puja, Offers Prayers At Yamuna Ghat
India.summary: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta celebrated Chhath Puja by offering prayers at a Yamuna Ghat. She performed Arghya to the setting Sun and prayed for the happiness, prosperity, and health of Delhi residents.

India.title: Kolkata Man Kills Ex-Girlfriend's Dogs, Shows It To Her On Video Call
India.summary: A Kolkata man killed his ex-girlfriend's two dogs and forced her to watch the act on a video call. A person she sent to check her flat found both animals dead with blood splattered inside.

India.title: Video: Speeding Car Rams Parked Jeep, Injures Woman In Himachal's Solan
India.summary: A speeding car rammed into a parked Jeep in Solan's Datauwal, Himachal Pradesh. The collision injured a woman and was captured on CCTV.

India.title: 'We Endure': Staying Indoors Not An Option, Workers Suffer The Tyranny Of Smog In Delhi
India.summary: Delhi's severe smog has driven customers online and kept tourists away from India Gate. However, outdoor workers must continue their daily labor on the streets despite the hazardous air.

India.title: 5 Killed, 11 Injured As Car Collides With Truck In Punjab's Fazilka
India.summary: Five people were killed and eleven others were injured when their car collided with a truck in Punjab's Fazilka. The accident happened near Theh Kalandar as the victims were returning from a wedding ceremony.

India.title: CIAL sets up facilitation centre for Sabarimala pilgrims
India.summary: The Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL) has established a facilitation centre for Sabarimala pilgrims. Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan is scheduled to inaugurate the new facility on November 17.

General.title: Staggered age of consent to be discussed after Brand case, minister says
General.summary: A woman who alleges she was raped by a jailed comedian at age 16 is campaigning to criminalize relationships between adults and 16- or 17-year-olds. A government minister stated that the proposal for a staggered age of consent will now be discussed.

General.title: Man and woman die and four arrested after police pursuit crash in Leeds
General.summary: A man and a woman died following a crash in Leeds that occurred during a police pursuit. Four people have been arrested on suspicion of causing death by dangerous driving.

General.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urged the United States and Elon Musk to remove remaining operational restrictions on Starlink satellite services in Ukraine. He stated that these current limitations are hindering Ukraine's ability to defend itself against Russian military attacks.

General.title: Ex-Met Police inspector lied about wife's death in Barbados hotel room, BBC learns
General.summary: A former Metropolitan Police inspector lied about the circumstances surrounding his wife's death in a Barbados hotel room. Warren Arter also faced separate allegations of sexually exploiting crime victims.

General.title: Minister backs legal right to job support for young people
General.summary: The work and pensions secretary supports a legal right to job support for young people. She stated that the current level of assistance is too vague.

General.title: Pope Leo rides in helicopter cockpit during Peru trip
General.summary: During his Latin America tour, Pope Leo rode in a helicopter cockpit. This occurred on the penultimate day of the trip before arriving in Cusco.
